title: Statement of cash flows — Birch Corp.
instructions: Prepare selected amounts for Birch Corp.'s Year 2 statement of cash flows using the **indirect method**, and classify the listed items.

exhibits.title: Year 2 data
exhibits.content:
- Net income: **$250,000**
- Depreciation expense: $40,000; patent amortization: $5,000
- Equipment with cost $50,000 and accumulated depreciation $30,000 was sold for **$12,000** cash
- New equipment purchased for **$90,000** cash
- Land acquired by issuing a **$150,000** note payable to the seller
- Bonds issued for $100,000 cash; a $40,000 bank note was repaid
- Cash dividends paid: $60,000; treasury stock purchased: $25,000
- Cash, January 1: **$80,000**

exhibits.title: Changes in working capital accounts
exhibits.content:
| Account | Change |
|---|---:|
| Accounts receivable | +22,000 |
| Inventory | −15,000 |
| Prepaid expenses | +3,000 |
| Accounts payable | +12,000 |
| Accrued liabilities | −6,000 |

rows.label: Net cash provided by operating activities
Net cash from investing activities (enter a use as negative)
rows.explanation: 12,000 proceeds − 90,000 purchase = **−78,000**. The land-for-note exchange is noncash.

rows.label: Net cash from financing activities (enter a use as negative)
Interest paid on the bank note
rows.explanation: U.S. GAAP classifies interest paid as operating.

rows.label: Land acquired with a note payable
rows.explanation: No cash changed hands; disclose it as a noncash investing and financing activity.

rows.label: Dividends received from an investee
rows.explanation: Dividends received are operating under U.S. GAAP.

rows.label: Proceeds from sale of equipment
rows.explanation: Proceeds from selling long-lived assets are investing inflows.
